snippet.title: 맛있다고 계속 먹었다간 골로가는 부위
snippet.description:
#돗돔 #전설의물고기 #생선간

전설의 물고기 돗돔입니다. 돗돔 간은 고소하면서 녹진한 맛이 일품인데요. 맛있다고 계속 먹었다간 큰일납니다. 비타민 A가 농축돼있어 사람에 따라 4~5점 이상 드시면 비타민 A 과다 섭취로 중독됩니다. 증상으로는 메스꺼움, 구토, 설사, 복통, 암 발병 증가, 탈모 등이 있으니 3점 까지만 드세요. 모든 생선 간이 그런건 아니지만 일부 심해어의 간, 수명이 10년 이상 된 노성어의 간, 돗돔의 간 등은 위험할 수 있습니다.(자세한 내용은 화면 아래 링크를 클릭해주세요.)

#BlueCrab #FemaleBlueCrab #RoeFullBlueCrab

Business Inquiries: fishingman@tmcentkorea.co.kr

Memories of the Bite Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/slds3

Memories of the Bite Naver Blog: https://blog.naver.com/slds2

Memories of the Bite Tistory Blog: https://slds2.tistory.com

Memories of the Bite Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/slds22

Subscribe to Memories of the Bite YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/입질의추억tv

Today, we are reviewing roe-filled female blue crabs, which are in season. Buying blue crabs online carries the risk of a gamble. I recommend visiting your regular shop or selecting them in person at a market if possible. When doing so, the most reliable methods are: 1) The more purple the belly plate is, the higher the probability of it being roe-filled. 2) Check if the crab's sharp spines on its sides have turned red. Today, we recreated the Buyong Blue Crab recipe from Chef Hu Deok-juk, who appeared on Black and White Chef 2. Subscribing to Memories of Fishing TV (for free) is an act of love~♥ Please also 'like' and turn on notifications! ^^

ja.title: 「身入り保証」の罠！知らないと損するカニの見分け方
ja.description:
今日は旬を迎えた卵たっぷりのメスワタリガニをレビューします。ネットでカニを購入するのは、やはり当たり外れの懸念があります。できれば行きつけの店や市場で、実際に目で見て選ぶことをお勧めします。

その際、最も確실한方法は：お腹の蓋(ふんどし)が紫色に近いほど、卵が入っている確率が上がること。カニの鋭い脇のトゲが赤く染まっているかを確認すること。今日は『白と黒の泥泥（モノクロ）料理人2』に出演されたフー・ドクジュク（後徳慶）シェフの「芙蓉蟹（プヨンケ）」を再現してみました。この動画が気に入ったら「サブスクリプション」よろしくお願いします。^^

Hari ini, kita akan mengulas kepiting biru betina yang sedang musimnya. Membeli kepiting biru secara online membawa risiko seperti berjudi. Saya sarankan untuk mengunjungi toko langganan Anda atau memilihnya langsung di pasar jika memungkinkan. Saat melakukannya, metode yang paling andal adalah: 1) Semakin ungu bagian perutnya, semakin tinggi kemungkinan berisi telur kepiting. 2) Periksa apakah duri tajam di sisi kepiting telah berubah menjadi merah. Hari ini, kami membuat ulang resep Kepiting Biru Buyong dari Chef Hu Deok-juk, yang tampil di Black and White Chef 2. en.title: "Guaranteed Meat?" Don't buy Blue Crabs without 'THIS'!
en.description:
Today, I’m reviewing seasonal female blue crabs full of roe. Buying crabs online always comes with the risk of a "hit or miss" outcome. I highly recommend buying them at a regular shop or a local market where you can check them in person.

The most reliable ways to choose are: The more purple the belly flap, the higher the chance it’s full of roe. Check if the sharp side spines of the crab are tinged with red. Today, I also recreated the "Puyong Blue Crab" dish by Chef Hu Deok-juk, who appeared in Culinary Class Wars 2. If you like my video, please click subscription and like. ^^

snippet.title: 맛있다고 계속 먹었다간 골로가는 부위
snippet.description:
#돗돔 #전설의물고기 #생선간

전설의 물고기 돗돔입니다. 돗돔 간은 고소하면서 녹진한 맛이 일품인데요. 맛있다고 계속 먹었다간 큰일납니다. 비타민 A가 농축돼있어 사람에 따라 4~5점 이상 드시면 비타민 A 과다 섭취로 중독됩니다. 증상으로는 메스꺼움, 구토, 설사, 복통, 암 발병 증가, 탈모 등이 있으니 3점 까지만 드세요. 모든 생선 간이 그런건 아니지만 일부 심해어의 간, 수명이 10년 이상 된 노성어의 간, 돗돔의 간 등은 위험할 수 있습니다.(자세한 내용은 화면 아래 링크를 클릭해주세요.)

#DottedGround #LegendaryFish #FishLiver

This is the legendary fish, the Dotted Ground. Its liver is renowned for its savory and rich flavor. However, eating too much just because it tastes good can be dangerous. It is highly concentrated with Vitamin A, so consuming more than 4 to 5 pieces can lead to Vitamin A poisoning depending on the individual. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, an increased risk of cancer, and hair loss, so please limit yourself to 3 pieces. While not all fish livers are like this, the livers of certain deep-sea fish, mature fish over 10 years old, and Dotted Ground livers can be dangerous. (Please click the link at the bottom of the screen for more details.)

참고로 가리비는 국산 참가리비, 국산이 없으면 북해도산 참가리비도 같은 맛이 납니다. 삼척중앙시장에서 구매했고요. 숙소 역시 삼척 해안가에 있는 펜션입니다. 저 처럼 시장에 들렀다가 문어, 한치, 생선회, 가리비, 소고기 등을 사다가 이렇게 해드시면 파인다이닝 부럽지 않는 저녁 식사가 될 거라고 믿어 의심치 않습니다. (자세한 리뷰는 화면 아래 링크를 클릭해주세요.)

#Scallops #JapaneseScallops #ScallopDishes

For reference, I used domestic Japanese scallops; if domestic ones aren't available, Hokkaido Japanese scallops taste just as good. I purchased them at Samcheok Central Market. My accommodation was also a pension located on the Samcheok coast. I have no doubt that if you stop by the market like I did to buy octopus, cuttlefish, sashimi, scallops, and beef to cook this meal, you will have a dinner that rivals fine dining. snippet.title: 상품성 최악 킹크랩을 구워먹었다니..
snippet.description:
#킹크랩 #탈피 #킹크랩구이

흔히 탈피한 킹크랩과 대게는 상품성이 현저히 떨어진다고 합니다. 이유는 허물을 벗는데 막대한 에너지를 쓰다보니 살과 장 수율이 떨어지기 때문이지요. 하지만 개체에 따라선 여전히 먹을만한 품질을 가진 것도 있습니다. 만약, 이런 킹크랩이나 대게를 탈피했다는 이유로 저렴하게 판매한다면 오히려 가성비가 될 수도 있습니다. 오늘은 탈피한 게를 어떤 방식으로 먹는지 알아봅니다.(자세한 풀영상은 화면 하단의 링크를 클릭해주세요.)

en-US.title: I can't believe I grilled and ate king crab that was of the worst quality..
en-US.description:
#KingCrab #Molting #GrilledKingCrab

It is commonly said that molted king crabs and snow crabs have significantly lower market value. This is because the massive energy expended shedding their shells results in a decrease in meat and organ yield. However, depending on the individual, some still possess quality good enough to eat. If such king crabs or snow crabs are sold at a lower price simply because they have molted, it could actually be a good value for money. Today, we explore how to eat molted crabs. en.title: This Clam Was So Delicious Chefs Tried to Keep It Secret… I’m Finally Revealing It. Sorry
en.description:
Today, I’m introducing a rare clam called Haengdal Clam, locally known in Goheung as the “Silk Clam.” For a long time, it was something only locals knew about and quietly enjoyed among themselves. In fact, considering how limited the harvest is, this might be one of those ingredients that was never meant to become widely known. However, as it recently began spreading rapidly through social media, it has started attracting serious attention from high-end restaurants and professional chefs. At this point, I began to wonder: if it’s already gaining attention, perhaps sharing information about this clam more openly could help expand awareness and eventually encourage increased production. If more people can at least experience its exceptional flavor and quality indirectly through this video, it might help create demand, leading to further research and potentially increasing its production in the future. That’s the reason I decided to introduce this remarkable clam today. If you like my video, please click subscription and like. ^^

오늘은 우리나라 유일의 미슐랭 3스타 레스토랑인 '밍글스'를 리뷰합니다. 더불어 한식의 세계화를 위해 우리나라도 파인다이닝의 위상이 높아지고 있지만, 이와 반대로 시대의 흐름을 역행하는 일부 시장 상인과 횟집의 저울치기 행태에 대해서도 꼬집었습니다. 아무쪼록 많은 관심과 시청 바랍니다. 입질의추억TV를 구독(무료)하는 것은 사랑입니다~♥ '좋아요와 알림설정도' 부탁드려요! ^^

- 총괄 및 기획 : 김지민, 조정연
- 촬영 및 가편집 : 김지민
- 종합 편집 : 안수영

#Mingles #FineDining #Michelin3Star

Today, we review Mingles, Korea's only Michelin 3-star restaurant. While fine dining is rising in Korea to globalize Korean cuisine, we also criticize the counterproductive behavior of some market vendors and raw fish restaurants, which are going against the trend. We hope you'll show your interest and enjoy the show. Subscribing to Ipjil's Memories TV (for free) is love~♥ Please 'like' and turn on notifications too! ^^

- Executive Director and Planning: Kim Ji-min, Jo Jeong-yeon
- Filming and Rough Editing: Kim Ji-min
- General Editing: Ahn Su-yeong

snippet.title: 횟집에서 유식해보이는 상식, 연어가 흰살생선인 이유
snippet.description:
#연어 #홍살치 #생선회

붉은살생선의 기준 → 100g당 미오글로빈이 10mg 이상, 흰살생선의 기준 → 100g당 미오글로빈이 10mg 미만이라야 합니다. 그 외 성분(예 : 아스타잔틴)으로 붉게 된 것은 붉은살의 기준이 될 수 없습니다. 결론, 눈에 보이는 색깔보단 성분과 함량에 의해 결정.(자세한 내용은 화면 아래 제목을 클릭해주세요)

Red fish standards: Myoglobin must be at least 10mg per 100g, while white fish standards: Myoglobin must be less than 10mg per 100g.
